name: Tessek Cardamom-Pandan Soft Chews
manufacturer: Tessek Foods (Corponation subsidiary of Halvorn Agri)
description: Individually wrapped synth-chews with a two-layer structure — outer cardamom shell that gives way to a softer pandan-cream center. Mass-produced to tight flavor tolerances, reliably consistent across all dispensary points in M88.
flavor_profile: Warm spice upfront from cardamom, transitioning to a cool, grassy-sweet pandan cream that melts slowly — mild and approachable
cultural_context: A standard offering in every school canteen, hospital waiting room, and office break station across M88. Not exciting, but universally trusted — the candy equivalent of a neutral handshake. People often give these to children or elderly relatives without worrying about sensitivities.
story_hooks: A batch of Tessek Cardamom-Pandan chews from a specific production run is causing mild BCI interference in augmented users — a manufacturing defect or something more deliberate?
A Tier 1 kid has been collecting the wrappers, which feature a rotating series of illustrated city landmarks — she's missing only one, and it may not exist.
Halvorn Agri is quietly reformulating the pandan center to cut costs, and a Tessek quality control employee is deciding whether to leak the change before it rolls out.
